entries.reason: Single Responsibility — The spec addresses one unified concern: fixing structural problems in the draft review architecture (exit code semantics, review loop, prompt-driven control). All in-scope items are causally related to this single concern. The Issue boundary is user-defined.; Task Single Responsibility — Each task addresses a single cohesive concern. T-5 touches registry.js + multiple prompt templates + SKILL.md, but all are bound to the same concern (shifting step-done responsibility from post hooks to prompt instructions). No task combines unrelated concerns.; Unambiguous Requirements — R8 specifies 'Claude CLI の既知 streaming event type のみ除去 (allowlist)' without enumerating the actual event type values (e.g., thread.started, content_block_start, etc.). 'Known' is subjective; two implementers could produce different allowlists. R3's 'STOP' on maxAttempts does not state the resulting step status (skipped / left as-in-progress / other).; Complete Context — R8 does not provide the concrete list of streaming event types to filter, so two independent reviewers cannot agree on whether a given implementation satisfies it. R7's SKILL.md update instruction ('review コマンドが step を自動 done しない旨を明記') leaves the exact wording and location unspecified.; REQ Diff-Verifiability — R9 requires executing 'sdd-forge upgrade' as a post-change process step. The requirement ('sdd-forge upgrade を実行して反映する') is an out-of-diff process invariant; its PASS/FAIL cannot be determined from diff + test execution summary alone. The resulting file changes would appear in diff, but the obligation to run the command is not testable from diff.; No Hardcoded Secrets — The spec contains no API keys, passwords, tokens, or other secrets. Not applicable by content nature.; No Silent Error Swallowing — R4 explicitly states that file-absence and parse errors continue to use process.exit(EXIT_ERROR). R5 specifies res.ok=false cases still throw. No unbounded processing is introduced.; Spec Includes Test Strategy — Every task (T-1 through T-7) has a test_strategy field specifying what to test and how (static template verification, unit tests with specific scenarios, npm test / npm run test:agent regression). The alternatives_considered section documents rejected options with reasons.; Spec Test Coverage — Acceptance criteria and per-task test strategies are defined. The argument interface of the review commands is unchanged, so no new validation specification is needed.
